definitions.gloss: visitor, attendee, person who comes to a venue
definitions.explanation: A person who visits or attends an event, exhibition, venue, or facility. A formal word commonly used in news and official announcements.

examples.japanese: {来場者|らいじょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of visitors is increasing.

examples.japanese: {来場者|らいじょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}った→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: We distributed a survey to the visitors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{過去最多|かこさいた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: This year's event recorded the highest number of visitors ever.

notes:
{来場者|らいじょうしゃ} refers to a person who visits or attends an event, exhibition, or venue. It is a formal compound used in official contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{来場|らいじょう}→来場：17703_raijou⟧ (coming to a venue) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ suffix creates a formal "person who..." compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来場者|らいじょうしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of visitors/attendees
- {来場者|らいじょうしゃ}⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧: visitor survey
- {来場者|らいじょうしゃ}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all visitors
- {来場者|らいじょうしゃ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: aimed at visitors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧: customer/visitor (casual, broader)
- ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧: participant (emphasizes active involvement)
- ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧: spectator, audience member (for shows/sports)
- ⟦{入場者|にゅうじょうしゃ}→入場者：23599_nyuujousha⟧: person entering a venue (focuses on admission)
